lines.text: Reclamation Site 01.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: When're you coming back?
I'll head down as soon as things are finished over here. Two weeks at the most.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Okay. I've got plenty to deal with on my end as well, so I'll see you at the Outpost.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You did really well.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Well, I promised that I'd make a grand entrance, didn't I?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, you did. You were amazing.
What about Neon, though?

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: I was going to say,

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: I haven't been able to get in touch with her.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Since it's Neon, I know she's probably fine, but the Outer Rim was where she was last seen.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: I can't help but worry.
Okay... I'll be there as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Good. Thanks.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Um... Commander.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Do you have anything else to say to me?

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Like, uh, any comments about my clothes... or stuff like that?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: They look a bit small on you.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: They're supposed to! That's the style!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If that's the case, you should probably change into something a little... more.

lines.speaker: anis_i_op_r
lines.text: Whatever. Just get here as soon as you can.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Will do. See you later.
See you.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, I think we should hurry.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm worried about Neon, and...
Rapi suddenly furrows her brow.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's too loud here.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: And then I took my heroic hammer—because I'm a hero—and BAM! Right on Behemoth's head!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: I keep telling you, it's Mjolnir.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I'm here talking about our achievements, and you keep going on about hitting me in the head.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: The hammer was super sturdy, so I, ever the hero, once again—

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I think we've heard enough about you assaulting my head.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Enough with such trivial things. Look at this! It's an attack I've been practicing that's shaped like a brachiosaur.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Th-that's amazing...! But shouldn't a brachiosaur have a longer neck?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Oh, you're right! Brilliant insight! You're officially a member of the Villain Union!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: GraGre has already joined, so there's only one spot left!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I never agreed to join. And my name's not GraGre.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: V-Villain Union? Wh-what do you do there...?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Wait, are you actually interested?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... yes? I think so?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but what do you do...?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Uh... Yeah, what do we do?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: How do you not know...?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Because she's not right in the head.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: All of you, be quiet. Can't you see that I, the staggeringly sagacious Bahamut, am trying to read?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You're holding the book upside down.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Books can be read just as well upside down. To think there is only one way to read a book is a parochial point of view!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: You're strange.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: My keen intellect senses a kindred spirit within you.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: We seem to be rather similar, you and I.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: She may as well be saying you look stupid.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: ... I take offense to that comparison.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hey! Don't you dare poach a member of the Villain Union!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I'm not part of the Villain Union.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Um, can someone help me carry this?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: The Evaluator got us snacks, and... Gah! They're falling...!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's okay. I got it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah... Why are there so many?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I thought everyone would be hungry, so I just brought everything.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There's no way we can finish all this.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh, don't worry about that! I could finish it by myself if needed.
There's plenty to go around, so don't be shy.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, awoo?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Is something wrong, Siren?
I'm glad everyone seems to be doing well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I am too. I was worried.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: But we worked together toward a common goal and managed to succeed.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I sense that perhaps even a small sense of camaraderie has formed.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah woo.
Come to think of it, I was so busy that I never really greeted you properly.
It's nice to meet you, Siren.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ah, ahhhh...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Siren.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Are you okay? You've been like this ever since meeting the Prince.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Does he make you uncomfortable?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're asking in front of him? That's... bold.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ah woo.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Haaah...
Little Mermaid approaches Cinderella and whispers.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: It's my first time talking to a man. I don't know what to say.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: He's the prince you've talked about, right? I think I've seen him before.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: He's handsome. He really does look like a prince, hehe.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We can all hear you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ahhh?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Can't help but exude charisma, can you, Prince Charming?
Very funny...
As the incident with the Four Beasts' Queen comes to a close,
we head back to Reclamation Site 01.
All the Nikkes that had been absorbed by the Queen are safe, and say that the inside was warm and comfortable.
They said their hostility melted away, and they just felt cozy.
I can't say for sure, but I imagine it felt like someone giving you a hug.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey! Don't steal my food!
Leviathan comes running this way with a fish skewer in her hand.
In front of her, a child is running with a grilled fish in her mouth.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hm...
Since the incident, the little girl hasn't once surrounded herself with Dark Matter.
Nor has she displayed any violent tendencies. In fact, she simply acts like any mildly disobedient child.
Her true identity is most likely akin to one of the Four Beasts, but for the moment, she doesn't seem dangerous. She appears to be in control.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Ah.
The child grabs onto my pant leg,
then stretches out both of her arms.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Hug me.
I bend down and pick the little girl up.
She's thankfully light.
She buries her head in my chest and then looks at me.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Daddy.
Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Daddy. Daddy.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hm...
Little Mermaid approaches Cinderella and whispers.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Um, Cinderella?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Is the Prince married?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No. At least, I don't think so.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We can still hear you.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Daddy.
Er... Um...
The child reaches her hand out to Rapi.
A puzzled Rapi reaches out her own hand, and the child grasps it.

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Mommy.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Haah!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hm...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah. I'm your mommy.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm Daddy's wife.
Wha...?! Oy.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey, I told you to stop stealing my... Aww, you ate it all!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: How can she eat so much?!

lines.speaker: onlyone
lines.text: Daddy. Mommy.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Congratulations on your kid, by the way.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Look at our daughter, Honey. Isn't she so pretty?
Stop... You're weirding me out.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: For now, let's just finish eating.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Uh, sure.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I grilled some fish. Let's eat them together.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Levi...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, yeah, let's eat together!

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I have a friend I want to introduce you to.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: A friend?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori. Can you come this way?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh? Why me?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah... Let's talk!
After a lively meal,
I have a talk with each individual group before I head back to the Ark.
First, Raptilion and Pinocchio.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: So, this is the town you live in! It's got a really nice vibe to it!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Whaley seems to like it too. She says she wants to rest here for as long as possible!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Don't you think it's a bit noisy, though? There doesn't seem to be any soundproofing.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah... Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: It's okay, so long as our Rapture friends don't get startled.
You can stay as long as you want.
Thanks to the optical camouflage, other Raptures won't attack.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We appreciate the hospitality! But we'll be leaving soon.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: There are still so many unknown lands we haven't seen!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: That's right. I want to see more, too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Where are you going this time?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: We still haven't decided. We'll take a gander at the sky and the landscape and go wherever our hearts take us!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Well, I wish you luck. Be careful out there.
Pinocchio, take care of Raptilion.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Of course! You take care too, Friend.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: See over there? Don't ever go that way.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: ... I understand. I'll be careful.
Next up are Cinderella and her companions.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We must find Hansel and Gretel.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We need them for the upcoming battle.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Siren said they're not on humanity's side.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Maybe we should give up on pursuing them.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hansel and Gretel cannot be left out of the happy ending that we are writing.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: They mean too much to us for that.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah... Very well. If that is how you feel, I will follow.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But you should be prepared. Things might not work out as you expect.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Do you know where they are?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Once our preparations are finished, we'll leave straightaway.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: What's wrong, Mori?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Oh, it's just...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: For me to be involved in such a big battle is a bit...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Haha... I'm not confident I'll be of much use.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I heard from Superhuman that, if not for you, we would've been done for.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Digging is the only thing I'm good at...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Mori, don't say that!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: B-but I...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: This won't do at all.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Y-you're right... I'm—

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We'll put you in special training.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Yes. Special training.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Er, huh?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: While we travel, you'll undergo special training.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: We'll put you through the wringer.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Until you stop saying foolish things like you're useless or that you're not good at anything.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Until you realize for yourself that you're beautiful.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: We're going to help you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Huh? Er...

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Why would you two go through all that?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: Just for someone like me...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hehe! You look happy, Mori!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: N-no, special training sounds hard. Why would I be... happy...?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: At any rate, we will be heading out on our own for a bit.
Yeah, I understand. Thank you for all your help.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'll come running whenever you need me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: And... we won't be gone too long.
You said the Queen is coming, right?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It is a loose end we must tie up.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: For her, we will need everyone to come together.
Of course. We'll make sure to get ready on our end. Are you heading out right away?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text:
Hehe. No, we also have to undergo some maintenance. 
A lot has happened, and without nearly any breaks at that.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I believe a little rest is in order.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Yes, we indeed require some rest.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Agreed. There are some nearby places I'd like to see, and I also have a lot to talk about with Levi!

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: E-Evaluator.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'm really okay now.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It's all thanks to you.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: It may take a little while, but next time we meet,

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I'll be an even better version of myself.
I'm looking forward to it.
Next are the Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So, what do we do now?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We made the Queen we wanted.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Our plan to give the Offsprings a good beating fizzled out,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: thanks to this pesky alliance you lot decided to form with us.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then it's safe to say you're on our side, right?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah, go ahead and think of it that way.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We won't ever betray you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Wow. You've become so agreeable.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then again, I do seem to recall you saying before that you knew deep down we're good people.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Th-that's...! B-be quiet!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Behemoth. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You looked like you were nudging Leviathan.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I was, because she kept running away instead of making a decision.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I was already going to go with whatever she decided, since I was pretty bad to all of you.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Anyway... here we are. Let's get along from now on.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I've got some things to make up for, so if you ever need anything, just let me know.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Er... All that stuff I heard from Cinderella and Siren.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Is it true?
... Yeah. I don't think it's a lie.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: The Queen...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wh-what is she coming down here for?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: There's no way to know.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-is there a chance she won't do anything? Like that child?
I look toward the other side of the room.
The child is lying on her back, sleeping soundly.
It seems she snores quite loudly.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That would be nice, but considering the Queen is the one who created the Raptures,

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I doubt she's just looking for a hug.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Are you going to try talking to her?
If she's willing.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Even if she is, it's unlikely to go well.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She created those insane Offsprings.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You need to be prepared.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: For battle, you mean?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: As expected, I, in my astonishing astuteness, understood everything merely from context clues. Even I am surprised by my intelligence.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yeah, you're a real genius.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: If the Offsprings are so strong, then the Queen must be...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: There's only one way we stand a chance.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Exactly. Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We have to raise the child.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: We have to join the Villain Union.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Are you serious? We're not joining that weird cult.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but they can make dinosaurs...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ugh... I think I'm getting a headache.
By "raise the child," you mean her?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She's calmed down now, but she had no trouble overpowering all of us.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: To say she has immense potential is an understatement.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Her power is on par with the Queen.
Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I know what you're going to say.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But I promise.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That child's power...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: will only be used for good.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Besides, we've no reason to fight in the first place if the Queen doesn't make a move.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Then allow me to ask.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: If the Queen indeed does not attack, what are we to do?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: An incisive question that hits the mark. It would appear you are at a loss for words.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... I don't know.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What should we do?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just live.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We do what we want, eat what we want.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Th-then I want to join the Villain Union! I-I think it sounds cool.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: And leave me?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You can come too.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No. No way. Even imagining it for a second made me sick.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Maybe I'll run an orchard, and just fill it with apple trees.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, with my penetrating perspicacity, will become a teacher.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: To hoard knowledge as brilliant as mine would be a crime against the world, so I will spread it far and wide.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Even the Villain Union sounds better than that...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Where are you planning on staying?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Staying here doesn't sound so bad,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: but people from the Ark will be in and out of here, right? I don't like the sound of that.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm fine cooperating with you all, but that doesn't mean I trust the Ark.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We'll go back to the Imitation Ark. It's better there.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But Liberalio swept everything away.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Restoring it sounds like a lot of fun, too.
Are you sure you can take good care of the girl?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: A child should be with her mother and father.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We'll make it work.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We made her, after all.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's only right that we take responsibility.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But why does she keep calling us her parents?

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the infinitely informed Bahamut, will explain. When a man—
Th-that's okay. You don't need to explain.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: You must not fear knowledge.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Anyway... uh...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Thanks for... everything.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: For giving me an opportunity to see Siren again.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: And... for accepting me as one of your own.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it louder, with more conviction?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I would like you so much more if you said so much less.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Anyway, take care on your way back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: If it looks like you're going up against the Queen, make sure to call us.
Will do. See you later.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: We'll be in touch.
Now for Matis.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: This'll probably give Syuen's reputation a boost.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: There are reports saying Matis played a major role—I guess?—in stopping this so-called Queen from reaching the Ark.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: So now we have a bit of a shield to use against all the attacks that come our way.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Haha! As heroes, our role is naturally to save others!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: The problem is the so-called Queen.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: She was broadcast live, though it looks like the stream was cut off right after Anis attacked.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Do you think the Ark will leave her be?
I find that very unlikely.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: She's with the Four Beasts, so things should be mostly fine. Admittedly, though, I'm still worried.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: She's calm now, but what if something provokes her and she transforms again...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Honestly, I don't think even all of the Ark's forces could take her down.
And on top of that, I'm told the real Queen is descending.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Let's wait and see how things play out before telling the Ark about that.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: They've already got enough headaches to deal with. If we tell them about the real Queen,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: they may snap and be all like, "Time for the Third Surface Reclamation!"
Yeah. It's best that we keep this close to the vest for now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What do you think is going to happen with the Queen?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Will we end up fighting her?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Most likely.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: While things aren't exactly peaceful right now, there's at least a lull,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: but it sounds like that could end at any moment.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Well, we can go over the details on the way back.
Yeah. Preparations will take around two weeks, so take your time getting ready.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Sure thing.
And finally, Liberalio.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I'll be honest.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: This whole experience changed my perspective.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I saw something change that I thought was incapable of changing.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Humans, Raptures, a human acting like a Rapture, some unknown thing, human imposters, Heretics, a former Heretic...

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: And the new Queen.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I saw them all gathered together, eating at the same table.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: You've managed to overcome your origins and actually communicate.
You should have joined us.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I wasn't in that sort of mood.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I was completely in awe.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I've lived a long life, but I've never felt like this before.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: My heart is racing. My body is warm.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: It's like a new path has been opened to me.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sounds like you've fallen in love.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Maybe I have.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Maybe I've fallen in love with this feeling of awe that I'd never even imagined before.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I must tell Mother about this.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I will persuade her,

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: tell her that a new path can be opened for us.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: That we can change, too.
What?

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I will attempt to reason with her.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: So, Human.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Hold off on making any rash decisions.
Sure... Okay. Thanks.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: We can have a conversation. Just like you did.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: I can't wait.

lines.speaker: liberalio
lines.text: Until then, try not to get yourself killed, Human.
That night...
The time passed almost in an instant as everyone shared stories they'd been waiting to tell and celebrated new friendships.
